title: PR #6490 moved structure-board rendering into a new generic render_object_structure admin endpoint and dropped the user_can_change_page check the old details() path applied, so any staff user can read the plugin structure of pages they may not view.

findings.explanation: The added checks ensure that a user must have add‑plugin permission on the source placeholder and that the source placeholder is viewable by the user before copying or moving plugins. This prevents IDOR and missing authorization on protected operations.

evidence.content:
@@ -533,11 +533,23 @@ class PlaceholderAdmin(BaseEditableAdminMixin, admin.ModelAdmin):
             language=source_language,
         )
         old_plugins = [source_plugin] + list(source_plugin.get_descendants())
         source_placeholder = source_plugin.placeholder
 
         if not self.has_copy_plugins_permission(request, old_plugins):
             message = _('You do not have permission to copy these plugins.')
             raise PermissionDenied(message)
 
         # Check source-side permission as well: copying reads the source
         # plugins, so a user without access to the source placeholder must not
         # be able to exfiltrate its content into their clipboard.
         if not source_placeholder.has_add_plugins_permission(request.user, old_plugins):
             message = _('You do not have permission to copy these plugins.')
             raise PermissionDenied(message)
 
         if not source_placeholder.check_source(request.user):
             message = _('You do not have permission to copy these plugins.')
             raise PermissionDenied(message)
 
         if not target_placeholder.check_source(request.user):
             message = _('You do not have permission to copy these plugins.')
             raise PermissionDenied(message)
